name: Modern Mongolian (Cyrillic)
description: Genuinely extensive, academic-grade curriculum spanning absolute beginner (A1) through classical mastery (C2) with zero gamification.

sections.title: Phonology, Cyrillic Alphabet & Vowel Harmony
sections.cyrillicTitle: Цагаан толгой, авиан зүй ба эгшиг зохицох ёс
sections.description: Master the 35 letters of Modern Mongolian Cyrillic, vowel categorization (masculine, feminine, neutral), and labial harmony.

sections.title: Greetings, Courtesies & Equative Sentences
sections.cyrillicTitle: Мэндчилгээ, танилцах ёс ба энгийн өгүүлбэр
sections.description: Polite forms of greeting, introducing oneself, asking names and origins, and zero-copula equative sentences.

sections.title: Family, Kinship & Dative-Locative Spatial Expressions
sections.cyrillicTitle: Гэр бүл, төрөл садан ба өгөх оршихын тийн ялгал
sections.description: Mongolian kinship terms, counting relatives, and indicating static location and destination with -д/-т.

sections.title: Food, Dairy Traditions & Accusative Direct Objects
sections.cyrillicTitle: Хоол хүнс, цагаан идээ ба заахын тийн ялгал
sections.description: Nomadic dairy products (цагаан идээ), traditional meat dishes, ordering food, and marking definite direct objects with -ыг/-ийг/-г.

sections.title: Five Livestock, Pastoral Life & Ablative of Origin
sections.cyrillicTitle: Таван хошуу мал, нүүдэлчин ахуй ба гарахын тийн ялгал
sections.description: The five sacred domestic animals, livestock age terminology, and origin, separation, or comparative standards with -аас/-ээс/-оос/-өөс.

sections.title: Steppe Geography, Nature & Instrumental Case of Means
sections.cyrillicTitle: Байгаль, газар зүй ба үйлдэхийн тийн ялгал
sections.description: The four biomes of Mongolia (Gobi, Khangai, Steppe, Taiga), rivers, and performing actions by means of tools with -аар/-ээр/-оор/-өөр.

sections.title: Seasons, Weather & Reflexive-Possessive Architecture
sections.cyrillicTitle: Улирал, цаг агаар ба өөртөө хамаатуулах нөхцөл
sections.description: Extreme seasonal transitions (зуд, цасан шуурга), seasonal encampments, and marking personal belongings with -аа/-ээ/-оо/-өө.

sections.title: Urban Life, Transport & Directional Case
sections.cyrillicTitle: Хотжилт, тээврийн хэрэгсэл ба чиглэхийн тийн ялгал
sections.description: Navigating Ulaanbaatar, public transit, city institutions, and expressing cardinal orientation towards targets with -руу/-рүү/-луу/-лүү.

sections.title: Daily Routines, Habits & Coordinating Converbs
sections.cyrillicTitle: Өдөр тутмын хэвшил ба зэрэгцүүлэн холбох нөхцөл
sections.description: Habitual actions (-даг), progressive present (-ж байна), and chaining actions performed sequentially by the same subject with -ж/-ч and -аад.

sections.title: Seasonal Migrations & Conditional Clause Structures
sections.cyrillicTitle: Нүүдэл суудал ба нөхцөлт холбох нөхцөл
sections.description: Pastoral seasonal migration (нүүдэл, отор), pasture conservation, and constructing hypothetical and temporal conditions with -вал/-вэл/-бал/-бэл.

sections.title: Naadam Games, Steppe Folklore & Concessive Clauses
sections.cyrillicTitle: Эрийн гурван наадам, аман зохиол ба харшлах холбох нөхцөл
sections.description: Wrestling, horse racing, archery, heroic epics, folk riddles, and articulating contrasts with -вч and боловч.

sections.title: Causative & Passive Voices in Society, History & Law
sections.cyrillicTitle: Үйлдэх ба үйлдэгдэх хэв: Түүх, нийгэм, хууль
sections.description: The Mongol Empire, Chinggis Khaan, governance, and transforming syntactic agency with causative (-уул) and passive (-гд) morphemes.

sections.title: Complex Converb Chaining & Discourse Hierarchy
sections.description: Forming periodic paragraphs with multiple subordinate converbs (-хаар, -магц, -тал, -саар) culminating on a single finite matrix verb.

sections.title: Economy, Mining, Technology & Ecology
sections.cyrillicTitle: Эдийн засаг, уул уурхай, экологи ба технологи
sections.description: Mongolia's mineral wealth, renewable energy transition, desertification countermeasures, and academic discourse markers.

sections.title: Honorific Registers, Statehood, Philosophy & Poetry
sections.cyrillicTitle: Хүндэтгэлийн найруулга, төрт ёс ба гүн ухаан
sections.description: Ceremonial address, lexical honorifics, Buddhist-Shamanic cosmology, constitutional governance, and classical rhetorical eloquence.

sections.title: Master Steppe Literature, Secret History & Classical Nuances
sections.cyrillicTitle: Монголын нууц товчоо, туульс ба дээд найруулга
sections.description: Close critical reading of the Secret History of the Mongols, heroic epics (Jangar, Geser), head-alliteration poetics, and archaic grammar registers.
